scope: Allow same-mode cross-group unified acceptance returns from both pasted TIDs and list selection.

behavior.selection: The top mode/group scope still applies. Select all groups for cross-group returns. Preview shows each original group and count.
behavior.transaction: One acceptanceBatchId and one transaction for the entire selected set. Each task keeps original groupId, movie and assignee; any stale or invalid selected task aborts the entire transaction.
behavior.flow: acceptance_fail with acceptanceInspection=uninspected; returns to original group QC as follow-batch return.
behavior.accuracy: Uninspected returns remain excluded from first actual acceptance accuracy. Workflow return counters and history still record them.
behavior.sampling: The separate group-based sampling form remains restricted to one group.
behavior.unchanged: API, workflow, reports, business data and other modes of operation. No service restart or forced refresh.
behavior.performance: The preview summary counts only selected preview rows, with no extra API requests or history aggregation.

deployment.rollback: Restore backed-up index with candidate SHA guard; keep versioned assets.

apiProofs: 同一事务按组使用不同 batchId 会被现有 API 拒绝，且没有任何部分保存

各组质检完整快照和增量同步只收到本组退回任务；跨组批次不混入其他组质检队列
单多镜混选、非验收身份和质检跨组处理全部原子拒绝；允许跨组的只有同模块验收角色
任一组出现过期任务、已处理任务或重复任务时，整个跨组名单零写入，其他组不会先被退回
并发跨组退回只有一个完整事务成功；另一方409，重试幂等且不会重复计入或漏退某组
退回后各原小组质检和标注可继续返修、提交、复检及第2轮验收，无需重新分组或改派
既有同组抽检通过/不合格组合和实检标记不变；未选任务、原始归属及数据库完整性保持
